🌟 Proxima | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified interface for developers to access and utilize multiple AI language models within their preferred coding environments without direct API key management.
✨ Key Features: • Connects multiple AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to coding tools
📖 Summary: Proxima is a multi-AI model connection server that integrates various large language models (like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity) into coding tools such as Cursor and VS Code. It enables users to leverage these AI models through free browser login sessions or local providers, featuring a self-healing Python agent, multi-agent delegation, and cross-session memory.
